purpose: Part 2/2 of verified hard-tail 19-record item effect batch 015; together these files contain exactly 19 self-contained reviewed records.

items/eye-of-sseth.name: Eye of Sseth
items/eye-of-sseth.effectSummary: A Scaled One can handle the coin safely, but the first other creature to touch it is exposed to contact poison (Fortitude DC 20; 1d6 Constitution initial and secondary damage), after which the poison is spent. If the last yuan-ti handler is alive, that yuan-ti is alerted across planes and learns the approximate distance, direction, and a mental image of the first non-Scaled One who touched it.

items/eyes-of-the-spider.name: Eyes of the Spider
items/eyes-of-the-spider.effectSummary: Putting on the device deals 2d6 damage and makes it irremovable until the wearer's death. The wearer gains continuous divine true seeing to 120 feet, all-around vision that prevents flanking, +4 Spot and Search, immunity to mind-affecting effects, and three daily 30-foot gaze attacks that force Fortitude DC 19 or deal 2d10 damage plus 1d4 Charisma drain.

items/flaming-burst-146.name: Flaming Burst
items/flaming-burst-146.effectSummary: A flaming burst weapon has the flaming property and deals extra fire damage on a successful critical hit: +1d10 for ×2, +2d10 for ×3, or +3d10 for ×4 critical multipliers. Ranged weapons pass the fire energy to their ammunition, and the burst damage applies on critical hits even when the flaming ability is inactive.

items/memento-magica.name: Memento Magica
items/memento-magica.effectSummary: Once per day on command, a memento magica restores one previously expended spontaneous spell slot of the level the item was created to hold. Versions exist for spell levels 1st through 9th, and each version restores only its designated slot level.

items/millennial-chainmail-608.name: Millennial Chainmail [Relic]
items/millennial-chainmail-608.effectSummary: For a chaotic-good, chaotic-neutral, or neutral-good wearer, the armor functions as +1 mithral chainmail, treated as light armor with maximum Dexterity bonus +8, armor check penalty -2, and 15% arcane spell failure. With the relic connection to Corellon Larethian, it grants fast healing 3 while the wearer is in brighter than shadowy illumination.

items/murlynds-hat.name: Murlynd's Hat
items/murlynds-hat.effectSummary: The hat grants a +2 insight bonus to Armor Class and to Will saves against charms and mind-affecting enchantments. It also allows fabricate three times per day.

items/rapier-of-unerring-direction-613.name: Rapier of Unerring Direction [Relic]
items/rapier-of-unerring-direction-613.effectSummary: The rapier functions as a +1 ghost touch rapier. With the relic connection to Fharlanghn, it automatically ignores all miss chances, including those from concealment, blink, displacement, or similar effects.

items/ring-ram-84.name: Ring of the Ram
items/ring-ram-84.effectSummary: The ring expends 1 to 3 charges to make a 50-foot ranged force attack dealing 1d6 damage per charge. Targets within 30 feet are also subject to a bull rush by a Large Strength 25 force with +1 or +2 on the check when 2 or 3 charges are spent; the ring can also open doors as Strength 25, 27, or 29 for 1, 2, or 3 charges, and a new ring has 50 charges.

items/robe-of-the-archmagi.name: Robe of the Archmagi
items/robe-of-the-archmagi.effectSummary: An arcane spellcaster wearing the robe gains +5 armor AC, spell resistance 17, +1 resistance on all saving throws, and the ability to overcome spell resistance as though using Spell Penetration. Wearing a robe of an incompatible alignment imposes two or three negative levels as specified by the robe's color and the wearer's alignment, lasting while the robe is worn.
